dcr_id: DCR-DBF1-NNN (to be assigned when registered; dcr_register_v2+ is maintained by the coordinator per DCR_PROCESS.md)

items.old_value: adjustable local match, on / immediately adjacent to the ICP module (match_colocated = true)
items.new_value: NOT PROPOSED HERE: the replacement is chosen only after a preregistered comparison (see evaluation_method)
follows DBF1-RF-03 (N_MATCH is present iff match_colocated)

physical_or_evidence_reason.finding: the co-located match node N_MATCH exceeds its continuous-use ceiling in every governing hot case of the preregistered P7 analysis: T_max 183.5 degC (TC4-HOT-I-B0; 147.2-180.6 degC in TC1-TC3) against the design ceiling 60 degC (EEE-INST-002 M1 Table 4 MIL-PRF-27 class S derated 110 degC minus the DBF1-TH-03 50 K), margin -123.5 K; it also exceeds the non-derated 130 degC rating
physical_or_evidence_reason.why_it_cannot_remain: the failure is not driven by RF power or by the design levers: the allowable forward power AL-PFWD/N_MATCH does not exist (the node fails at P_fwd = 0 W, heated by conduction from the ICP bracket at 186-211 degC, which carries the Hall discharge-return heat of the ion collector), and the node fails at every R_HALL grid point (0.02-0.40 m^2, 2-10 W/K)
physical_or_evidence_reason.evidence_class: model-derived (NP-THERMAL-CATHODELESS 2.0.0, PARAMETRIC, NOT_VALIDATED) on registered engineering assumptions: the match mounting conductance 0.5 W/K to the ICP bracket, a 0.02 m^2 match radiating face, and the 5 % match loss are assumed values (P3-K-06 TBD)

resolution_paths_to_evaluate.description: keep the match co-located but thermally isolate it from the ICP bracket and give it its own radiating face (mounting conductance and radiator area are not DBF-1 values; they were not levers of P7 prereg v1, so they need a P7 preregistration addendum before evaluation)

move the match off the module to the RF-generator side (match_colocated = false; N_MATCH absent; TK-04 / TK-05 booked at B_PPU_RF RF_CHAIN), with the RF consequence of the remote match (A9.2 local-match selection) evaluated by the P2 impedance map

evaluation_method: preregister (committed alone, hash-locked) the comparison of R-1 and R-2 before evaluating either: R-1 as a P7 addendum lever set (match conductance to bracket, match radiator area) on the unchanged prereg v1 cases; R-2 as DBF-1.1 with the N_MATCH-absent topology; acceptance = every governing hot case N_MATCH (R-1) or the B_PPU_RF RF_CHAIN unit (R-2) within its ceiling under the 50 K / 1.2 rule, and no other node verdict degraded
results_seen_before_request: P7 thermal_closure_v1 (all governing, cold, sensitivity and allowable results in the record)
M2 DBF-1 record and the A9.38 closure board as read by every lane (no Hall thrust value)

records: docs/closure/thermal/thermal_closure_v1.json stays immutable; a rerun after R-1 or R-2 writes thermal_closure_v2
impact.power: R-2 moves the match loss to the RF-generator side (B_PPU_RF) and adds coax loss; L-POWER-ICD ledger
impact.icp: R-2 changes the RF reference plane (P2 impedance map; L-ICP-CLOSURE)

new_baseline: DBF-1.1 only if R-2 is selected
